## Milestone M1 - Project Structure Inspection Complete

---

## 1. ROOT DIRECTORY OVERVIEW

```
/Users/Ori/Documents/Projects/BunkerGame/
├── .agents/                    # Agent configuration files
├── .bunker_agent/              # Bunker agent configs
├── .continue/                  # Continue session data

├── .gemini/                    # Gemini integration
├── .nexus/                     # Nexus plugin/state files
├── .opencode/                  # OpenCode integration

├── agents/                     # Agent definitions (bunker-builder.md, bunkergame-art-director.md)
├── artifacts/                  # Generated outputs from AI tools and workflows

├── backups/                    # Backup directories
├── cube/                       # Cube 3D generation (cube/outputs/)

├── models/                     # 3D model files (currently empty)

├── REVEAL/                     # Reveal stage outputs
├── UNEASE.                     # Unease stage outputs
├── src/                        # Rojo-mapped Roblox source directories
├── tools/                      # Automation and tooling scripts
└── Multiple .rbxlx build variants (BunkerGame-*, bunkergame-*)
```

---

## 2. ROJO SOURCE MAPPING (default.project.json)

The project uses **Rojo v7.7.0** for source-to-game mapping:

| Roblox Service | Source Path | Contents |
|----------------|-------------|----------|
| ReplicatedStorage | `src/ReplicatedStorage` | Game/, GeneratedAssets/, Remotes.model.json |
| ServerScriptService | `src/ServerScriptService` | Game/ |
| StarterGui | `src/StarterGui` | (empty) |
| StarterPlayer.StarterPlayerScripts | `src/StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts` | GameClient/ |
| Workspace | `src/Workspace` | Runtime objects |

---

## 3. SOURCE CODE STRUCTURE (`src/`)

### ReplicatedStorage/Game/
- `Config.luau` - Game configuration
- `Definitions.luau` - Type definitions
- `NetTypes.luau` - Network type definitions
- `ProfileSchema.luau` - Profile schema
- `WorldManifest.luau` - World manifest

### ReplicatedStorage/GeneratedAssets/
- `AssetRegistry.json` / `AssetRegistry.luau` - Asset registry

### StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/GameClient/
- `ClientBootstrap.client.luau` - Client bootstrap
- `ClientState.luau` - Client state management
- `InputController.luau` - Input handling
- `UIController.luau` - UI controller

---

## 4. DOCUMENTATION HIERARCHY (`docs/`)

### docs/director/ (Director Bible)
- `CURRENT-TASK.md` - Active implementation task
- `GAME-VISION.md` - Game vision document
- `TECH-BIBLE.md` - Technical bible
- `WORLD-BIBLE.md` - World design bible
- `UI-BIBLE.md` - UI specifications
- `ART-BIBLE.md` - Art bible
- `GAMEPLAY-BIBLE.md` - Gameplay mechanics
- `FULL-GAME-CONTRACTS.md` - Full game contracts
- `MASTER-GAME-GAP-MATRIX.md` - Gap matrix
- And 10+ additional director documents

### docs/ai/ (AI System Documentation)
- `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `SYSTEMS.md`, `MODULES.md`
- Domain docs: `ECONOMY.md`, `INVENTORY.md`, `POWER.md`, `ZOMBIES.md`, `FARMING.md`, etc.

### docs/world/
- `FOREST_GEOMETRY_AUDIT.md`
- `FOREST_GEOMETRY_INVENTORY.json`

### docs/design/
- `TERRAIN-SPEC.md`

---

## 5. TOOLS DIRECTORY (`tools/`)

| Category | Contents |
|----------|----------|
| ai_3d_pipeline/ | AI 3D pipeline tools |
| assistant_bloxforge_bridge/ | BloxForge bridge integration |
| bds/ | BDS validation commands (doctor, inspect, ast, review) |
| builders/ | Builder bot automation |
| bunkergame-mcp/ | MCP integration files |
| concept_benchmark/ | Concept benchmarking tools |
| environment_director/ | Environment director tooling |
| overnight_aaa_watchdog.py | Watchdog process |
| roblox_3d_generator/ | Roblox 3D generation tools |
| synthetic_sol_v2/ | Synthetic Sol v2 tools |
| terrain_backup/ | Terrain backup utilities |
| visual_qa/ | Visual QA tools |
| workflows/ | Workflow automation (preflight, postflight, cutover) |

---

## 6. ASSETS DIRECTORY (`assets/`)

- `create_textured_bunk_bed.py` through `v5` - Iterative asset creation scripts
- `generated_meshes/` - Generated mesh outputs
- `load_and_texture_mesh.py`, `texture_existing_mesh.py` - Texture tools
- `textured_bunk_bed.py`, `textured_bunk_bed_simple.py` - Bed texture scripts
- `textures/` - Texture assets

---

## 7. ARTIFACTS DIRECTORY (`artifacts/`)

Contains outputs from:
- AI 3D generation (ai_3d/)
- BloxForge MCP integration (bloxforge_direct_mcp/)
- Concept benchmarking (concept_benchmark/)
- Environment art proofs (environment-art-proofs/)
- Full game candidate builds (full_game_candidate/, full_game_cutover_journal/)
- Greenfield bunker variants (greenfield_bunker/)
- HY Pano variants (hy_pano_bunker/, hy_pano_qwen/)
- Overnight AAA watchdog logs and state files
- World mirror artifacts (worldmirror_bunker/ series)

---

## 8. KEY SCRIPTS AND UTILITIES

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `builder_bot.py` | Builder bot automation |
| `check_pine.py` | Pine checking utility |
| `create_crate_service.py` | Crate service creation |
| `cube3d_setup.py` | Cube 3D setup |
| `debug_api.py`, `debug_api.sh`, `debug_api_2.sh` | Debug API tools |
| `explore_api.sh` | Exploration API script |
| `health_check.sh` | Health check utility |
| `run_all.sh` | Main runner script |
| `call_api.sh`, `opencode.json` | API integration files |

---

## 9. ROBLOX STUDIO BUILD VARIANTS (.rbxlx)

Multiple build variants representing different phases:
- **Foundation/Gate**: BunkerGame-Foundation-Gate.rbxlx, BunkerGame-migration-gate.rbxlx
- **SVS01 Series**: attributes-fixed, diagnostics, implement, static-clean, static
- **Director Variants**: director-creepy-pass, final-director, legacy-removed
- **Exterior/World**: exterior-world-pass, forest-world-pass
- **Phase 6 Focus**: bunkergame-phase6-* (20+ variants covering electrical, vfx, silhouette, runtime)
- **Special Passes**: ammo-crate, audio-cleanup, lighting-atmosphere, UI-polish

---

## 10. ASSET INVENTORY (asset_list.txt)

16 defined assets:
1. reinforced steel bunker door
2. stone tunnel entrance archway
3. concrete barricade
4. industrial metal air vent
5. shabby wooden merchant stall
6. vintage glowing lantern
7. antique cash register
8. canned food supply
9. emergency medkit
10. gas mask
11. military tactical flashlight
12. walkie talkie radio
13. rusty metal barrel
14. wooden ammo crate
15. military bunk bed
16. old power generator

---

## 11. PROJECT CHARACTERISTICS

- **Engine**: Roblox with Rojo source mapping (v7.7.0)
- **Validation**: BDS tooling for syntax/AST validation
- **Architecture**: Multi-agent system with Director Brain pattern
- **Development Model**: Phased approach (PARTIAL → REVEAL → UNEASE)
- **AI Integration**: Synthetic Sol v2, Wan MLX, BloxForge MCP
- **Documentation Style**: Comprehensive bibles and contracts

---

## 12. MULTI-AGENT WORKFLOW

Per AGENTS.md:
- Primary agent acts as Director/Orchestrator
- Major work follows: architecture → implementation → QA → integration review → Director approval
- Shared contracts have single owner
- Follows CURRENT-TASK.md when active
- Uses workflow scripts (preflight, postflight, run-current-task)

---
